exposure: Delivery of a stillbirth at an antecedent delivery
cohort: 440 women with previous cesarean deliveries who delivered at Mbarara Regional Referral Hospital (MRRH) in southwestern Uganda
finding: Short interbirth interval was prevalent (33%) among women with prior cesarean deliveries, and associated factors included non-use of PPFP, history of stillbirth, unplanned pregnancy, and younger maternal age.
